description: This file contains user-related actions for the Mattermost web application, including loading user profiles, team and channel members, handling direct messages, and user autocomplete functionalities.

methods.name: loadProfilesAndReloadTeamMembers
methods.description: Loads user profiles in a team and reloads team members, optionally reloading all members.

methods.name: loadProfilesAndReloadChannelMembers
methods.description: Loads user profiles in a channel and reloads channel members, optionally reloading all members.

methods.name: loadProfilesAndTeamMembers
methods.description: Loads user profiles in a team and loads team members.

methods.name: searchProfilesAndTeamMembers
methods.description: Searches for user profiles and loads team members based on a search term.

methods.name: searchProfilesAndChannelMembers
methods.description: Searches for user profiles and loads channel members based on a search term.

methods.name: loadProfilesAndTeamMembersAndChannelMembers
methods.description: Loads user profiles in a channel and team, and loads both team and channel members.

methods.name: loadTeamMembersForProfilesList
methods.description: Loads team members for a list of user profiles.

methods.name: loadTeamMembersAndChannelMembersForProfilesList
methods.description: Loads team and channel members for a list of user profiles.

methods.name: loadChannelMembersForProfilesList
methods.description: Loads channel members for a list of user profiles.

methods.name: loadNewDMIfNeeded
methods.description: Ensures a direct message channel is visible and loads profile if needed.

methods.name: loadNewGMIfNeeded
methods.description: Ensures a group message channel is visible and loads profile if needed.

methods.name: loadProfilesForGroupChannels
methods.description: Loads profiles for a list of group channels.

methods.name: loadProfilesForSidebar
methods.description: Loads profiles for direct messages and group messages for sidebar display.

methods.name: getGMsForLoading
methods.description: Retrieves channels of type GM for loading profiles.

methods.name: loadProfilesForGM
methods.description: Loads profiles for GM channels, managing preferences and emoji loading.

methods.name: autoResetStatus
methods.description: Automatically resets user status to online if conditions are met.
